qualification: Source branch traces only; no full Workshop/Pelt/GPU execution. Tinct unit execution is separate.

export_policy_reset.precondition: A successfully loaded/saved clean library and host-supplied protected paths/directories. Pelt supplies its appearance path once when EditorWindow opens.
export_policy_reset.transition: WorkshopState::reopen loads a fresh Self whose constructor has empty protection vectors, then replaces the entire current state. Native sync_and_export does not reinstall those vectors.
export_policy_reset.consequence: Subsequent complete_export no longer refuses the external host path. Existing targets still require the ordinary explicit replace confirmation; automatic overwrite was not observed. Workshop-owned library/preferences checks still exist.

graph_repaint.precondition: An ordinary frame with the graph leaf laid out at a stable size and unchanged state.
graph_repaint.transition: Native frame calls PreviewBindings::register, which inserts a new state.graph_leaf. GraphCanvas::new sets dirty true and registry insert replaces the old leaf.
graph_repaint.consequence: The next render_into cannot take its clean-cached skip; graph paint/epoch changes on every eligible pass. Does not establish a continuous redraw loop, GPU duration or measured latency.
